lesson.title: Cato's last night
lesson.hook: at Utica in 46 BCE, refusing Caesar's pardon, Cato reads Plato on the soul through the night, and his ending is told honestly, not as a model

title: reach out before morning
cast: today: a young man in Johannesburg and his friend.
note: The lesson tells Cato's death. Show no death or method, ever. Better as a type-led day. If filmed, the end card must show 988 (US) or local emergency help.
